lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Your gift card is a free loan. To the store.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Until you spend it, they hold your money. No interest.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: So who's had it all this time?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Americans are sitting on about $27 billion in unused gift cards.
lines.spoken: Americans are sitting on about twenty-seven billion dollars in unused gift cards.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And the part we forget? Stores can count it as revenue.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: One coffee chain alone booked $188 million of forgotten balances in one year.
lines.spoken: One coffee chain alone booked a hundred and eighty-eight million dollars of forgotten balances in one year.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But the rules are on your side. Full case, linked below.
